what_survives_the_correction.note: ~86 GiB required against ~37.9 GiB available. The lane's conclusion holds for the full-resident path, for the right reason.

what_the_correction_overturns.note: ~2.11 GiB required against ~37.9 GiB available. This path is NOT memory-blocked. The lane's headline said T1-T5 is infeasible on memory grounds; on the streaming-adapter path that reason is wrong.

controller_correction.what_the_lane_got_wrong: It reported observed_free_gib 0.104 and reasoned from it. On macOS, 'Pages free' is not available memory: inactive and speculative pages are reclaimable on demand.
controller_correction.why_this_correction_matters: 'Not enough memory' is not actionable and would have retired the lane. 'No data' is actionable. The corrected picture moves T1's blocker from a hardware wall to an acquisition decision that belongs to the user.

machine.load_note: machine observed at load ~29–31 of 28 cores during this assessment; timings contaminated

T0.reason: integrity, data classification, single-layer authority, known-failure registry — implemented

T1.reason: smallest meaningful streaming-adapter step needs ~2.3 GB working set; full-resident needs ~92.3 GB; observed free ~0.10 GiB on a 96 GiB machine already holding other campaigns. Training corpora are DECLARED_NOT_PRESENT.

T2.reason: QAT requires forward+fake-quant+backward through the same 92 GB substrate. Operator simulation on small tensors is runnable; full QAT is not.

T3.reason: Needs parent trajectory traces (teacher manifest PARTIAL — layer capsules only) plus multi-token forward of the student; same memory wall as T1 plus sequence length.

T4.reason: F1–F4 require a served model and evaluated prompt set; serve path is memory-bound and another lane.

T5.reason: Depends on T1–T4 checkpoints and a live evaluation path against held-out items.

verdict.controller_amended_headline: Full-resident T1-T5 training does not fit: ~86 GiB required against ~37.9 GiB available. The streaming-adapter path does fit on memory and is blocked instead by missing training corpora and insufficient teacher traces. T0 reproductions and contract machinery are runnable now.
verdict.headline: T1–T5 training against the 92 GB Math-Preserve artifact is not feasible on this 96 GB machine at current load and free memory. T0 reproductions and contract machinery are. This is a finding, not a task to silently shrink.
